response.justification: Bogdan has extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) and demonstrates strong technical skills in full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and AI-agent tooling. However, his focus has been broader (web, mobile, embedded systems) rather than specialized in AI or cloud strategy, and there is limited evidence of entrepreneurial/startup experience or recognized AI expertise in product/platform building. His recent role in AI-agent infrastructure is promising but not deeply aligned with the role's AI strategy focus.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, and cloud).
Recent contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (e.g., MCP code generators) show technical innovation.
Strong open-source contributions and entrepreneurial experience (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) demonstrating initiative and leadership.
concerns: Lacks clear evidence of deep AI/ML expertise or recognized expertise with AI-powered products/platforms.
No graduate degree (Master's/PhD) in an AI-related field, which is preferred for this role.
Most recent roles emphasize engineering execution (e.g., full-stack development) rather than strategic AI/cloud innovation.

key_factors.factor: AI/ML expertise and strategic product/platform building
Entrepreneurial/startup experience or recognized AI innovation
Cloud and AI technology fluency with builder/code design skills
